sql.if: and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id=rm.menu_id where rm.role_id=r.role_id and m.status='0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms!='' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and ( r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and c.owner_id=#{currentUserId}) ) )

and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id=rm.menu_id where rm.role_id=r.role_id and m.status='0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms!='' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and ( r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and (c.owner_id=#{currentUserId} or c.main_lawyer_id=#{currentUserId} or find_in_set(#{currentUserId}, ifnull(c.assistant_lawyer_ids,'')))) ) )

mapper.sql: p.plan_id planId, concat('YS', date_format(ifnull(p.create_time, sysdate()), '%Y%m%d'), lpad(p.plan_id, 4, '0')) receivableNo, p.contract_id contractId, c.contract_no contractNo, c.contract_name contractName, ca.case_id caseId, ca.case_no caseNo, ca.case_name caseName, c.customer_id customerId, c.customer_name customerName, c.case_type caseType, p.period_no periodNo, p.receivable_amount receivableAmount, ifnull(p.received_amount, 0) receivedAmount, greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(p.received_amount, 0), 0) pendingAmount, p.plan_receive_date planReceiveDate, case when p.plan_receive_date is null then 0 else greatest(datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date), 0) end agingDays, case when p.confirm_status='2' then 'rejected' when p.confirm_status='1' and ifnull(p.received_amount,0) >= p.receivable_amount then 'received' when p.confirm_status='1' and ifnull(p.received_amount,0) < p.receivable_amount then 'partial' when p.plan_receive_date is not null and p.plan_receive_date < curdate() then 'overdue' else 'pending' end receivableStatus, p.confirm_status confirmStatus, p.invoice_status invoiceStatus, c.owner_id ownerId, u.nick_name ownerName, c.risk_level riskLevel, p.remark, p.create_time createTime, p.update_time updateTime
mapper.select: select 'receivableTotal' metricKey, coalesce(sum(p.receivable_amount),0) metricValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'receivedTotal', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'pendingTotal', coalesce(sum(greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end,0),0)),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'overdueTotal', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status!='1' and p.plan_receive_date < curdate() then p.receivable_amount - ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'monthReceived', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and date_format(p.update_time,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m') then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'pendingInvoiceTotal', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status in ('0','2') then ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0'

select date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m') itemName, coalesce(sum(ifnull(p.received_amount,0)),0) itemValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.confirm_status='1' and p.update_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 month)
group by date_format(p.update_time, '%Y-%m') order by itemName asc

select bucket itemName, count(*) itemValue, coalesce(sum(pendingAmount),0) amountValue from ( select case when p.plan_receive_date is null or datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) <= 0 then 'current' when datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) <= 30 then 'd30' when datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) <= 60 then 'd60' when datediff(curdate(), p.plan_receive_date) <= 90 then 'd90' else 'd90plus' end bucket, greatest(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(p.received_amount,0),0) pendingAmount from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.confirm_status!='1'
) t group by bucket

select 'contracts' metricKey, count(distinct c.contract_id) metricValue, coalesce(sum(c.sign_amount),0) amountValue from biz_contract c where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'matters', count(distinct ca.case_id), coalesce(sum(ifnull(c.sign_amount,0)),0) from biz_contract c left join biz_case ca on ca.contract_id=c.contract_id and ca.del_flag='0' where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'expenses', count(distinct e.expense_id), coalesce(sum(e.amount),0) from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0'

select 'overdueReceivable' metricKey, count(*) metricValue, coalesce(sum(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(p.received_amount,0)),0) amountValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.confirm_status!='1' and p.plan_receive_date < curdate()
union all select 'pendingInvoice', count(*), coalesce(sum(ifnull(p.received_amount,0)),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status in ('0','2')
union all select 'highRisk', count(*), coalesce(sum(p.receivable_amount - ifnull(p.received_amount,0)),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' and c.risk_level='3' and p.confirm_status!='1'

select 'income' metricKey, coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end),0) metricValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'cost', coalesce(sum(e.amount),0) from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' union all select 'arrears', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status!='1' then p.receivable_amount - ifnull(p.received_amount,0) else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' union all select 'invoicePending', coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' and p.invoice_status in ('0','2') then p.received_amount else 0 end),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0'

select ifnull(c.lawyer_name, '未指定') itemName, coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end),0) itemValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id where c.del_flag='0' group by ifnull(c.lawyer_name, '未指定') order by itemValue desc limit 8

select ifnull(c.case_type, 'unknown') itemName, coalesce(sum(e.amount),0) itemValue from biz_case_expense e left join biz_case c on c.case_id=e.case_id where e.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' group by ifnull(c.case_type, 'unknown') order by itemValue desc limit 8

select ifnull(u.nick_name, '未指定') itemName, coalesce(sum(case when p.confirm_status='1' then p.received_amount else 0 end),0) itemValue from biz_contract_fee_plan p left join biz_contract c on c.contract_id=p.contract_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.owner_id where c.del_flag='0' group by ifnull(u.nick_name, '未指定') order by itemValue desc limit 8
